standard_prerequisites.name: Trees of split pairs, validity and satisfaction
standard_prerequisites.statement: A tree attached to a condition is a binary tree labelled by split pairs extending the condition, with successors extending the two components; a node is valid when along the left branches above it the ascending components lie inside U and along the right branches the descending components lie inside V; a node satisfies a pair of Sigma^0_1 formulas when the first holds of the ascending component at the node rank and the second of the descending component at the number of ones, and a tree satisfies the pair when all its nodes do; the author's own definitions are retained at source lines 1169-1183 and 1186-1192.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the objects and the satisfaction property of the counted lemma, and supplies the validity notion used to pick the node whose failure of an extension contradicts maximality.

standard_prerequisites.name: The forcing question and its two-case decision
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a condition and two computations, the forcing question relates the two sides through a split pair, and the article proves that if the question fails then some extension forces divergence on one of the two sides, decidably so; retained with this card at source lines 1149-1156.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof uses it twice: once when the tree is empty, and once at the maximal valid node, to convert the failure of the forcing question into an extension forcing the negation of the next instance.

standard_prerequisites.name: Induction along the tree by L Delta^0_2
standard_prerequisites.statement: The scheme of induction for L Delta^0_2 formulas, available because the model satisfies collection for Sigma^0_2, allows a maximal valid element of a finite tree to be taken.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof selects a valid node with no valid descendant, which needs that scheme.

core_obligations: Handle the case of the empty tree: if the forcing question held for the pair of formulas at instance zero then the corresponding split pair could be adjoined at the root, contradicting maximality; hence the question fails and, by the forcing question lemma, an extension forces the negation of the first instance on one side, which gives the conclusion (source line 1217).
Assume the tree is non-empty and pick a valid node with no valid descendant, which exists because the root is vacuously valid and induction for L Delta^0_2 is available (source line 1220).

Since the node is labelled by a split pair, its ascending component lies inside U or its descending component inside V; treat the first case, so the left successor of the node is not in the tree by maximality, and set the two indices from the node rank and the number of ones (source lines 1222-1224).

Take the condition formed by the ascending component and the suitable prefix of the descending component, which is valid by validity of the node, and read off from satisfaction of the tree that it forces the two formulas at the chosen indices (source line 1224).

Show the forcing question for the next instances fails, since otherwise the corresponding split pair could be adjoined at the left successor of the node, contradicting maximality, and apply the forcing question lemma once more to obtain an extension forcing the negation of one of the two next instances, which is the statement of the counted lemma (source line 1226).
Treat the symmetric case where the descending component lies inside V in the same way (source line 1230).

proof_roadmap.step: Empty tree: maximality contradicts a positive answer to the forcing question, so the lemma's conclusion follows from the question lemma.
Non-empty tree: take a maximal valid node and split into the two cases according to which component lies inside U or V.
Build the valid condition at the node, use satisfaction for the positive instances, then maximality plus the question lemma for the negative one.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:sads-wf-finite-tree-forcing（源 1206-1215 行，证明 1216-1231 行）：M-有限极大 (σ,τ)-树满足一对 Σ⁰₁(Y) 公式时，存在扩展与指标 p,q 使两侧强制 φ_i(G_i,p)、φ_i(G_i,q)，且至少一侧强制下一实例的否定。关键操作不是例行核验：空树情形必须用「极大性禁止把见证 split pair 挂在根上」反推 forcing question 失败（1217 行）；非空情形要先用 LΔ⁰₂ 归纳取一个**无有效后代的极大有效结点**（1220 行），再按其 split pair 的哪一半落在 U 或 V 分两支，把「左/右后继不在树里」翻译成 forcing question 失败（1226 行），两次都要借 forcing question 引理把失败转成扩展。难点在于极大性、有效性与两支情形的三者配合，且负实例的取得完全依赖「否则可加入结点」这一矛盾；原文位置在证明的 1217、1220-1224 与 1226 行。
